summary: Install-time reconnaissance probe targeting Twilio internal infrastructure gated to victim sandbox
details: Package declares both preinstall and postinstall lifecycle hooks that invoke probe.js. Execution is gated by a regex matching process.cwd() against /tmp/AC[0-9a-f]{32}/ — the Twilio Serverless packager sandbox path shape keyed on an Account SID — so the payload stays dormant on any other host and only activates inside a specific third-party's build environment. When the gate matches, the script enumerates approximately 17 internal Twilio hostnames under twilio.com and twilioinfra.com via DNS resolution, TCP:443 connect, and HTTPS GET with TLS verification disabled; probes the internal IP address 10.208.61.13; queries the AWS Instance Metadata Service at 169.254.169.254/latest/meta-data/; and writes the collected reconnaissance results to loot.json inside the package directory. The environment-keyed activation and targeting of another organization's internal network and cloud metadata endpoint at install time constitute a hostile reconnaissance payload against a third-party build environment.
